text.en: Ilium behind the posterior gluteal line including the adjacent crest, dorsal lower sacrum and side of the coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, thoracolumbar fascia and fascia over gluteus medius.
text.zh: 髂骨后臀线后方及邻近髂嵴、骶骨下部背面和尾骨侧面、骶结节韧带、胸腰筋膜及覆盖臀中肌的筋膜。

text.en: Most fibres enter the iliotibial tract; deeper lower fibres reach the gluteal tuberosity of the femur.
text.zh: 大部分纤维止于髂胫束，深层下部纤维止于股骨臀肌粗隆。

direction.en: Broad bundles run down and out towards the outer thigh.
direction.zh: 宽大的肌束向外下斜行，走向大腿外侧。

feel.en: Put a palm on the buttock and gently take the leg backwards without arching the back. The broad muscle firms up.
feel.zh: 手掌轻放在臀部，同侧腿轻轻后伸，下背不后仰；掌下变硬的大片肌肉就是臀大肌。

mistakes.en: Finishing a hinge by leaning back through the waist.
mistakes.zh: 髋铰链动作起身后继续后仰，用腰代替伸髋。

mistakes.en: Dropping into a squat faster than you can control.
mistakes.zh: 下蹲太快，到了底部已经稳不住。

summary.en: Extends the hip and turns the thigh outward.
summary.zh: 伸髋，并使大腿外旋。

detail.en: The broad outer layer of the buttock pulls the thigh back, or lifts the pelvis over a planted thigh [M109]. Upper fibres can assist abduction; not every bundle has the same line of pull. Squats, lunges and hinges use it with other hip extensors. Finish tall, with the ribs over the pelvis.
detail.zh: 臀大肌位于臀部最浅层。收缩时把大腿向后拉；脚踩稳时，也能把骨盆带回大腿上方 [M109]。上部纤维可协助外展，各肌束的拉力方向并不完全相同。深蹲、弓步和髋铰链动作会同时用到其他伸髋肌。起身后站稳即可，不必继续后仰。

text.en: Outer ilium between the iliac crest and posterior gluteal line above and the anterior gluteal line below, and the overlying gluteal aponeurosis.
text.zh: 髂骨外面：上至髂嵴及后臀线、下至前臀线，并包括覆盖其表面的臀筋膜。

text.en: Oblique ridge on the lateral surface of the greater trochanter.
text.zh: 股骨大转子外侧面的斜嵴。

direction.en: Fan-shaped fibres converge down towards the greater trochanter.
direction.zh: 扇形纤维向下汇聚到大转子。

feel.en: Touch the upper outer buttock while gently lifting the leg sideways. This locates the medius region, not every individual fibre.
feel.zh: 手放在臀部外上方，轻轻向侧面抬腿。这里只能认臀中肌的大致位置，不能分清每束纤维。

mistakes.en: Leaning the trunk sideways to raise the leg.
mistakes.zh: 靠躯干侧倾把腿带起来。

mistakes.en: Assuming a hip drop alone proves muscle weakness.
mistakes.zh: 只凭骨盆歪斜就断定肌肉无力。

summary.en: Abducts the hip and steadies the pelvis.
summary.zh: 外展髋关节，并稳住骨盆。

detail.en: This fan lies partly under gluteus maximus [M109]. On a support leg it helps resist the opposite side of the pelvis dropping. Rotation varies with the fibre region and hip position; the action list does not assign one fixed role to every fibre. Lunge links show support-leg control, not isolated abductor training.
detail.zh: 这块扇形肌部分被臀大肌盖住 [M109]。单脚支撑时，它帮助抵抗对侧骨盆下落。旋转作用随纤维位置和髋姿势而变，作用表不代表所有纤维方向一致。弓步主要让它参与支撑侧控制，并不能把它单独练出来。

text.en: Outer ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines, extending posteriorly to the margin of the greater sciatic notch.
text.zh: 髂骨外面前臀线与下臀线之间，后方到坐骨大切迹边缘。

text.en: Anterior border of the greater trochanter, with an expansion to the hip capsule.
text.zh: 股骨大转子前缘，并有扩展连到髋关节囊。

direction.en: Fan-shaped fibres converge down towards the greater trochanter.
direction.zh: 扇形纤维向下汇聚到大转子。

feel.en: Touch the upper outer buttock while gently lifting the leg sideways. The deep minimus cannot be felt separately.
feel.zh: 手放在臀部外上方，轻轻向侧面抬腿。臀小肌在深处，无法单独摸到。

mistakes.en: Leaning the trunk sideways to raise the leg.
mistakes.zh: 靠躯干侧倾把腿带起来。

mistakes.en: Assuming a hip drop alone proves muscle weakness.
mistakes.zh: 只凭骨盆歪斜就断定肌肉无力。

summary.en: Abducts the hip and steadies the pelvis.
summary.zh: 外展髋关节，并稳住骨盆。

detail.en: This fan lies under gluteus medius [M109]. On a support leg it helps resist the opposite side of the pelvis dropping. Rotation varies with the fibre region and hip position; the action list does not assign one fixed role to every fibre. Lunge links show support-leg control, not isolated abductor training.
detail.zh: 这块扇形肌位于臀中肌深面 [M109]。单脚支撑时，它帮助抵抗对侧骨盆下落。旋转作用随纤维位置和髋姿势而变，作用表不代表所有纤维方向一致。弓步主要让它参与支撑侧控制，并不能把它单独练出来。

text.en: Rectus femoris begins on the pelvis; the three vasti begin on the femur. Their cards give the specific surfaces.
text.zh: 股直肌起于骨盆，其余三块股肌起于股骨；具体骨面见各肌卡。

text.en: Base of the patella through the quadriceps tendon; force continues through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.
text.zh: 经股四头肌腱止于髌骨底，拉力再经髌韧带传到胫骨粗隆。

direction.en: Four heads converge into the tendon above the patella.
direction.zh: 四个头向髌骨上方的共同肌腱汇聚。

feel.en: Gently straighten a knee while seated and touch the front of the thigh, away from the kneecap.
feel.zh: 坐着轻轻伸膝，手放在大腿前面，避开髌骨。

mistakes.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inward.
mistakes.zh: 负重时膝盖突然向内塌。

mistakes.en: Twisting a loaded knee to isolate a head.
mistakes.zh: 负重时扭膝，想单独练某一个头。

summary.en: Extends the knee; one head also flexes the hip.
summary.zh: 伸膝，其中股直肌还参与屈髋。

detail.en: Four heads share the knee-extensor tendon [M109] [M59]. Rectus femoris crosses hip and knee; the vasti cross only the knee. In a squat the joints move together, so the length change of rectus femoris differs from that of the vasti. These exercise links train the group, not independent switches for its heads.
detail.zh: 股四头肌四个头共用伸膝肌腱 [M109] [M59]。股直肌跨髋、膝，其余三块股肌只跨膝。深蹲时两个关节一起动，股直肌的长度变化因此不同于其余三头。动作链接练的是肌群，不能把各头当作独立开关。

text.en: Anterior inferior iliac spine and the groove just above the acetabulum, by straight and reflected tendons.
text.zh: 髂前下棘，以及髋臼上方的沟，分别以直头和返折头起始。

text.en: Base of the patella through the quadriceps tendon; force continues through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.
text.zh: 经股四头肌腱止于髌骨底，拉力再经髌韧带传到胫骨粗隆。

direction.en: Fibres run obliquely on either side of a central tendon.
direction.zh: 纤维从中央腱两侧斜向下排列。

feel.en: Touch the middle front of the thigh during a gentle seated knee extension. Avoid pressure on the kneecap.
feel.zh: 坐着轻轻伸膝，手放在大腿正前方。不要压髌骨。

mistakes.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inward.
mistakes.zh: 负重时膝盖突然向内塌。

mistakes.en: Twisting a loaded knee to isolate a head.
mistakes.zh: 负重时扭膝，想单独练某一个头。

summary.en: Extends the knee and helps lift the thigh.
summary.zh: 伸膝，并协助抬大腿。

detail.en: Rectus femoris crosses hip and knee. Hip extension and knee flexion lengthen it; the opposite motions shorten it [M109]. Squats change both joints together, so knee bending alone does not show its stretch. The linked squats train the knee-extensor group, rather than isolating this head. Gray describes bipennate superficial fibres and deeper fibres running straight to an aponeurosis [M109].
detail.zh: 股直肌跨髋、膝。伸髋和屈膝会把它拉长，反向运动会使它缩短 [M109]。深蹲时两个关节一起变化，不能只看屈膝就判断它被拉长多少。链接练的是整个伸膝肌群，并不单独练股直肌。Gray 描述浅层纤维呈双羽状，深层纤维直行至腱膜 [M109]。

text.en: Upper intertrochanteric line, anterior and inferior borders of the greater trochanter, lateral lip of the gluteal tuberosity and upper lateral lip of the linea aspera; also the lateral intermuscular septum.
text.zh: 转子间线上部、大转子前缘及下缘、臀肌粗隆外侧唇和粗线外侧唇上部，也起于外侧肌间隔。

text.en: Lateral border of the patella, blending with the quadriceps tendon and lateral patellar retinaculum; force continues through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.
text.zh: 髌骨外侧缘，汇入股四头肌腱及髌外侧支持带；拉力经髌韧带传至胫骨粗隆。

direction.en: Oblique bundles descend from the outer femur towards the common tendon.
direction.zh: 肌束从股骨外侧斜向下，汇入共同肌腱。

feel.en: Touch the outer front of the thigh during a gentle seated knee extension. Avoid pressure on the kneecap.
feel.zh: 坐着轻轻伸膝，手放在大腿前外侧。不要压髌骨。

mistakes.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inward.
mistakes.zh: 负重时膝盖突然向内塌。

mistakes.en: Twisting a loaded knee to isolate a head.
mistakes.zh: 负重时扭膝，想单独练某一个头。

summary.en: Extends the knee through the common tendon.
summary.zh: 通过共同肌腱伸膝。

detail.en: This head crosses only the knee and joins the common quadriceps tendon [M109]. It makes up much of the outer thigh. Squats and lunges load it with the other knee extensors.
detail.zh: 这块肌肉只跨膝，并汇入共同股四头肌腱 [M109]。它构成大腿外侧的较大部分。深蹲和弓步中，它与其余伸膝肌共同受力。

text.en: Lower intertrochanteric line, medial lip of the linea aspera, upper medial supracondylar line, medial intermuscular septum and adjoining adductor longus and magnus tendons.
text.zh: 转子间线下部、粗线内侧唇、内侧髁上线的上部、内侧肌间隔及相邻长收肌和大收肌腱。

text.en: Medial border of the patella, blending with the quadriceps tendon and medial patellar retinaculum; force continues through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.
text.zh: 髌骨内侧缘，汇入股四头肌腱及髌内侧支持带；拉力经髌韧带传至胫骨粗隆。

direction.en: Upper bundles descend outward; lower bundles approach the patella more horizontally.
direction.zh: 上部肌束向外下走，下部肌束较横向地靠近髌骨。

feel.en: Touch the inner front of the thigh during a gentle seated knee extension. Avoid pressure on the kneecap.
feel.zh: 坐着轻轻伸膝，手放在大腿前内侧。不要压髌骨。

mistakes.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inward.
mistakes.zh: 负重时膝盖突然向内塌。

mistakes.en: Twisting a loaded knee to isolate a head.
mistakes.zh: 负重时扭膝，想单独练某一个头。

summary.en: Extends the knee through the common tendon.
summary.zh: 通过共同肌腱伸膝。

detail.en: This head crosses only the knee and joins the common quadriceps tendon [M109]. Its lower oblique fibres are often called VMO; this is not an independent muscle, and foot angle does not guarantee isolation. Squats and lunges load it with the other knee extensors.
detail.zh: 这块肌肉只跨膝，并汇入共同股四头肌腱 [M109]。健身里常把下部斜行纤维叫作 VMO；这个称呼不代表独立肌肉，也不能保证改变脚尖方向就能单独练它。深蹲和弓步中，它与其余伸膝肌共同受力。

text.en: Anterior and lateral surfaces of the upper two-thirds of the femoral shaft and lower part of the lateral intermuscular septum.
text.zh: 股骨干上三分之二的前面、外侧面，以及外侧肌间隔下部。

text.en: Base of the patella through the quadriceps tendon; force continues through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.
text.zh: 经股四头肌腱止于髌骨底，拉力再经髌韧带传到胫骨粗隆。

direction.en: Deep longitudinal and oblique bundles run towards the patella.
direction.zh: 深层纵向和斜向肌束走向髌骨。

feel.en: Touch the front of the thigh during a gentle seated knee extension. This deep head cannot be felt separately.
feel.zh: 坐着轻轻伸膝，手放在大腿前方。股中间肌在深处，无法单独摸到。

mistakes.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inward.
mistakes.zh: 负重时膝盖突然向内塌。

mistakes.en: Twisting a loaded knee to isolate a head.
mistakes.zh: 负重时扭膝，想单独练某一个头。

summary.en: Extends the knee through the common tendon.
summary.zh: 通过共同肌腱伸膝。

detail.en: This head crosses only the knee and joins the common quadriceps tendon [M109]. It lies under rectus femoris and cannot be distinguished by touch. Squats and lunges load it with the other knee extensors.
detail.zh: 这块肌肉只跨膝，并汇入共同股四头肌腱 [M109]。它在股直肌深面，无法靠触摸单独辨认。深蹲和弓步中，它与其余伸膝肌共同受力。

text.en: Long head: ischial tuberosity. Short head: lateral lip of the linea aspera, lateral supracondylar line and lateral intermuscular septum.
text.zh: 长头起于坐骨结节；短头起于粗线外侧唇、外侧髁上线及外侧肌间隔。

text.en: Head of the fibula through a shared tendon, with a small expansion to the lateral tibial condyle.
text.zh: 经共同止腱到腓骨头，并有小束到胫骨外侧髁。

direction.en: Two heads converge along the outer back of the thigh into one distal tendon.
direction.zh: 两个头在大腿后外侧向下汇入共同肌腱。

feel.en: Gently bend the knee against resistance and touch the outer posterior thigh above the knee crease.
feel.zh: 轻轻抗阻屈膝，摸膝后褶皱上方的大腿后外侧。

mistakes.en: Locking the knees and reaching down by rounding the back.
mistakes.zh: 膝盖硬锁，却靠弯腰去够地面。

mistakes.en: Assuming every hamstring part extends the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把所有腘绳肌部分都当作伸髋肌。

summary.en: Bends the knee; its long head also extends the hip.
summary.zh: 屈膝；长头还伸髋。

detail.en: Two heads share the lateral hamstring tendon [M109]. The long head spans hip and knee; the short head starts on the femur and spans only the knee. Outward rotation of the lower leg is described with the knee bent. A hinge trains hip extension by the long head; it is not a direct short-head exercise. The arrangement entry is a composite of the two heads, not a claim that every fascicle follows one geometry [M75] [M77].
detail.zh: 股二头肌两个头共用外侧止腱 [M109]。长头跨髋、膝；短头从股骨开始，只跨膝。使小腿外旋的作用是在屈膝时描述的。髋铰链动作通过伸髋让长头受力，不能据此说它直接练到了短头。排列栏概括两个头，并不表示每根肌束都遵循一种几何结构 [M75] [M77]。

text.en: Ischial tuberosity, sharing a proximal tendon with semitendinosus, and adjacent sacrotuberous ligament.
text.zh: 坐骨结节，与半腱肌共用近端腱，并连于邻近骶结节韧带。

text.en: Head of the fibula through a shared tendon, with a small expansion to the lateral tibial condyle.
text.zh: 经共同止腱到腓骨头，并有小束到胫骨外侧髁。

direction.en: Bundles descend along the outer posterior thigh towards the lateral knee tendon.
direction.zh: 肌束沿大腿后外侧向下，汇入膝外侧肌腱。

feel.en: Touch the outer posterior thigh during a gentle resisted knee bend. The long head is superficial here.
feel.zh: 轻轻抗阻屈膝时摸大腿后外侧。长头在这里比较浅。

mistakes.en: Locking the knees and reaching down by rounding the back.
mistakes.zh: 膝盖硬锁，却靠弯腰去够地面。

mistakes.en: Assuming every hamstring part extends the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把所有腘绳肌部分都当作伸髋肌。

summary.en: Crosses hip and knee; pulls the thigh back.
summary.zh: 跨髋、膝，能把大腿往后拉。

detail.en: The long head begins on the pelvis and crosses hip and knee. Hip flexion with a straighter knee lengthens it, as in a Romanian deadlift [M109]. A seated curl fixes the hip in flexion while the knee moves, giving a different starting length. The lunge link includes assistance and stabilisation. The belly is spindle-shaped; a cadaver study describes its fascicle arrangement as unipennate [M75]. Shape and fibre arrangement describe different features [M77].
detail.zh: 长头从骨盆开始，跨髋、膝。屈髋且膝较直时会被拉长，例如罗马尼亚硬拉 [M109]。坐姿腿弯举固定髋在屈位，让膝运动，起始长度因此不同。弓步中它参与协同与稳定。肌腹外形似梭；尸体研究将其肌束排列描述为单羽状 [M75]。外形与纤维排列描述的是不同特征 [M77]。

text.en: Lateral lip of the linea aspera, lateral supracondylar line and lateral intermuscular septum.
text.zh: 股骨粗线外侧唇、外侧髁上线及外侧肌间隔。

text.en: Head of the fibula through a shared tendon, with a small expansion to the lateral tibial condyle.
text.zh: 经共同止腱到腓骨头，并有小束到胫骨外侧髁。

direction.en: Short oblique bundles enter the shared distal aponeurosis of biceps femoris.
direction.zh: 短而斜行的肌束汇入股二头肌共同的远端腱膜。

feel.en: Touch the outer posterior thigh during a gentle resisted knee bend. The partly hidden short head cannot be separated by touch.
feel.zh: 轻轻抗阻屈膝时摸大腿后外侧。短头部分被盖住，无法靠触摸单独辨认。

mistakes.en: Locking the knees and reaching down by rounding the back.
mistakes.zh: 膝盖硬锁，却靠弯腰去够地面。

mistakes.en: Assuming every hamstring part extends the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把所有腘绳肌部分都当作伸髋肌。

summary.en: Crosses only the knee and bends it.
summary.zh: 只跨膝关节，使膝弯曲。

detail.en: The short head starts on the thigh bone, not the pelvis. It bends the knee but cannot extend the hip [M109]. The seated curl directly loads knee flexion. Squat and lunge links show joint control and co-contraction, not equivalent short-head growth exercises. A cadaver study describes the short head as converging onto the long head’s distal tendon, rather than a separate spindle-shaped belly [M75].
detail.zh: 短头从股骨开始，不从骨盆开始。因此它能屈膝，不能伸髋 [M109]。坐姿腿弯举直接练屈膝；深蹲和弓步链接展示关节控制与共同收缩，不能视为同等的短头增肌动作。尸体研究描述短头向长头的远端肌腱汇聚，不能把它当成另一块独立梭形肌腹 [M75]。

text.en: Lower medial impression of the ischial tuberosity, sharing a proximal tendon with biceps femoris long head.
text.zh: 坐骨结节下内侧的印迹，与股二头肌长头共用近端起腱。

text.en: Upper medial tibia, in the pes anserinus.
text.zh: 胫骨上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足。

direction.en: Bundles descend down the inner back of the thigh into a long cord-like tendon.
direction.zh: 肌束沿大腿后内侧向下，汇入细长绳状肌腱。

feel.en: Touch the inner posterior thigh during a gentle resisted knee bend. The long tendon approaches the inner knee; avoid pressing into the knee crease.
feel.zh: 轻轻抗阻屈膝，手放在大腿后内侧。长腱靠近膝内侧，不要用力按膝窝。

mistakes.en: Locking the knees and reaching down by rounding the back.
mistakes.zh: 膝盖硬锁，却靠弯腰去够地面。

mistakes.en: Assuming every hamstring part extends the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把所有腘绳肌部分都当作伸髋肌。

summary.en: Extends the hip and bends the knee.
summary.zh: 伸髋、屈膝；屈膝时使小腿内旋。

detail.en: An inner hamstring spanning hip and knee [M109]. Its long tendon joins sartorius and gracilis at the pes anserinus. It rotates the lower leg inward when the knee is bent. Hinges and curls alter its length differently; a stretch is not a reason to force the range. Here “fusiform” describes the spindle-like outline, not a claim that every fibre is parallel; dissected specimens show oblique pennate fibres entering the aponeuroses [M77].
detail.zh: 大腿后内侧的腘绳肌，跨髋、膝 [M109]。长腱与缝匠肌、股薄肌腱共同构成鹅足。屈膝时能使小腿内旋。髋铰链和腿弯举改变肌长的方式不同；有牵拉感不意味着应该继续加深幅度。这里“梭形”描述肌腹轮廓，不表示每根纤维都平行；离体标本可见斜行的羽状纤维汇入腱膜 [M77]。

text.en: Upper lateral impression of the ischial tuberosity, through a broad flat tendon.
text.zh: 坐骨结节上外侧的印迹，经宽扁肌腱起始。

text.en: Groove on the posteromedial surface of the medial tibial condyle, with expansions including the oblique popliteal ligament of the posterior knee capsule.
text.zh: 胫骨内侧髁后内侧面的沟，并有扩展构成膝后关节囊的腘斜韧带等结构。

direction.en: Bundles descend down the inner back of the thigh into a broad tendon.
direction.zh: 肌束沿大腿后内侧向下，汇入宽大的肌腱。

feel.en: Touch the inner posterior thigh during a gentle resisted knee bend. This deeper muscle cannot be reliably separated by touch.
feel.zh: 轻轻抗阻屈膝，手放在大腿后内侧。这块肌肉较深，触摸不能可靠地把它单独辨出来。

mistakes.en: Locking the knees and reaching down by rounding the back.
mistakes.zh: 膝盖硬锁，却靠弯腰去够地面。

mistakes.en: Assuming every hamstring part extends the hip.
mistakes.zh: 把所有腘绳肌部分都当作伸髋肌。

summary.en: Extends the hip and bends the knee.
summary.zh: 伸髋、屈膝；屈膝时使小腿内旋。

detail.en: An inner hamstring spanning hip and knee [M109]. Its name refers to its broad proximal tendon; it lies deep to semitendinosus. It rotates the lower leg inward when the knee is bent. Hinges and curls alter its length differently; a stretch is not a reason to force the range. Its pennate architecture varies by region: proximal unipennate regions and a distal bipennate region make one simple feather label incomplete [M76].
detail.zh: 大腿后内侧的腘绳肌，跨髋、膝 [M109]。名称来自宽扁的近端腱；肌腹位于半腱肌深面。屈膝时能使小腿内旋。髋铰链和腿弯举改变肌长的方式不同；有牵拉感不意味着应该继续加深幅度。羽状结构随部位变化：近端有单羽状区，远端有双羽状区；一种简单羽形标签无法概括全肌 [M76]。

text.en: Front of the pubic body below the pubic crest.
text.zh: 耻骨体前面，耻骨嵴下方。

text.en: Middle third of the medial lip of the femoral linea aspera.
text.zh: 股骨粗线内侧唇中段。

direction.en: Bundles run down and out from the pelvis to the medial femur.
direction.zh: 肌束从骨盆向外下斜行到股骨内侧。

feel.en: Notice the upper inner thigh during a gentle inward press of the leg. Touch lightly below the groin crease.
feel.zh: 轻轻把腿向内压，留意大腿上部内侧的用力感。可轻触腹股沟褶皱下方。

mistakes.en: Forcing a stance wider than the hips can comfortably manage.
mistakes.zh: 把站距撑得太宽，超过髋部舒服的范围。

mistakes.en: Swinging the leg or turning the pelvis to move the cable.
mistakes.zh: 甩腿或转动骨盆来拉动绳索。

summary.en: Adducts the thigh and assists hip flexion.
summary.zh: 内收大腿，并协助屈髋。

detail.en: Adductor longus lies at the front of the inner thigh [M109]. Cable adduction directly practises the inward pull. Squats and lateral lunges use it within a larger movement; they do not isolate this muscle.
detail.zh: 长收肌位于大腿内侧的前部 [M109]。绳索内收直接练向内拉；深蹲和侧弓步中，它参与整个动作，并不会被单独练出来。

text.en: Body and inferior ramus of the pubis.
text.zh: 耻骨体及耻骨下支。

text.en: Pectineal line and upper medial lip of the femoral linea aspera.
text.zh: 股骨耻骨肌线及粗线内侧唇上段。

direction.en: Bundles run down and out from the pelvis to the medial femur.
direction.zh: 肌束从骨盆向外下斜行到股骨内侧。

feel.en: Notice the upper inner thigh during a gentle inward press of the leg. Deep adductors cannot be separated by touch.
feel.zh: 轻轻把腿向内压，留意大腿上部内侧的用力感。深层收肌无法靠触摸单独分清。

mistakes.en: Forcing a stance wider than the hips can comfortably manage.
mistakes.zh: 把站距撑得太宽，超过髋部舒服的范围。

mistakes.en: Swinging the leg or turning the pelvis to move the cable.
mistakes.zh: 甩腿或转动骨盆来拉动绳索。

summary.en: Adducts the thigh and assists hip flexion.
summary.zh: 内收大腿，并协助屈髋。

detail.en: Adductor brevis lies behind adductor longus [M109]. Cable adduction directly practises the inward pull. Squats and lateral lunges use it within a larger movement; they do not isolate this muscle. The origin uses the modern body/inferior-ramus description; Gray’s older wording names both pubic rami [M109] [M59].
detail.zh: 短收肌位于长收肌后方 [M109]。绳索内收直接练向内拉；深蹲和侧弓步中，它参与整个动作，并不会被单独练出来。起点采用现代教材的耻骨体及下支描述；Gray 的旧版措辞提到耻骨上下支 [M109] [M59]。

text.en: Adductor part: inferior pubic ramus and ischial ramus. Hamstring part: ischial tuberosity.
text.zh: 内收部起于耻骨下支、坐骨支；腘绳肌部起于坐骨结节。

text.en: Adductor part: gluteal tuberosity, linea aspera and medial supracondylar line. Hamstring part: femoral adductor tubercle.
text.zh: 内收部止于臀肌粗隆、粗线及内侧髁上线；腘绳肌部止于股骨收肌结节。

direction.en: Bundles run down and out from the pelvis to the medial femur.
direction.zh: 肌束从骨盆向外下斜行到股骨内侧。

feel.en: Notice the upper inner thigh during a gentle inward press of the leg. Deep adductors cannot be separated by touch.
feel.zh: 轻轻把腿向内压，留意大腿上部内侧的用力感。深层收肌无法靠触摸单独分清。

mistakes.en: Forcing a stance wider than the hips can comfortably manage.
mistakes.zh: 把站距撑得太宽，超过髋部舒服的范围。

mistakes.en: Swinging the leg or turning the pelvis to move the cable.
mistakes.zh: 甩腿或转动骨盆来拉动绳索。

summary.en: Adducts the thigh; parts assist flexion or extension.
summary.zh: 内收大腿；不同部分还参与屈髋或伸髋。

detail.en: A large deep sheet with adductor and hamstring parts [M109]. The adductor part can assist flexion; the more vertical ischial fibres assist extension. Despite its hamstring part, the muscle does not cross the knee. In squats it can assist hip extension as well as control the thigh.
detail.zh: 大收肌是一片深层大肌，分内收部和腘绳肌部 [M109]。内收部可协助屈髋，来自坐骨的较纵向纤维协助伸髋。虽然有“腘绳肌部”，它并不跨膝。深蹲中，它可协助伸髋，也参与控制大腿。

text.en: Pecten pubis and adjacent superior pubic ramus.
text.zh: 耻骨梳及邻近耻骨上支。

text.en: Pectineal line of the femur below the lesser trochanter.
text.zh: 股骨小转子下方的耻骨肌线。

direction.en: Bundles run down and out from the pelvis to the medial femur.
direction.zh: 肌束从骨盆向外下斜行到股骨内侧。

feel.en: Notice the upper inner thigh during a gentle inward press of the leg. Pectineus is near the groin vessels; do not press deeply.
feel.zh: 轻轻把腿向内压，留意大腿上部内侧的用力感。耻骨肌靠近腹股沟血管，不要深按。

mistakes.en: Forcing a stance wider than the hips can comfortably manage.
mistakes.zh: 把站距撑得太宽，超过髋部舒服的范围。

mistakes.en: Swinging the leg or turning the pelvis to move the cable.
mistakes.zh: 甩腿或转动骨盆来拉动绳索。

summary.en: Adducts the thigh and assists hip flexion.
summary.zh: 内收大腿，并协助屈髋。

detail.en: Pectineus lies at the front of the upper inner thigh [M109]. Cable adduction directly practises the inward pull. Squats and lateral lunges use it within a larger movement; they do not isolate this muscle.
detail.zh: 耻骨肌位于大腿根前内侧 [M109]。绳索内收直接练向内拉；深蹲和侧弓步中，它参与整个动作，并不会被单独练出来。

text.en: Body and inferior ramus of the pubis beside the pubic symphysis.
text.zh: 耻骨体及耻骨下支，邻近耻骨联合。

text.en: Upper medial tibia, in the pes anserinus below the medial condyle.
text.zh: 胫骨内侧髁下方的上端内侧面，参与构成鹅足。

direction.en: A thin strap runs almost vertically along the inner thigh.
direction.zh: 细长带状纤维沿大腿内侧近乎纵向下行。

feel.en: Lightly touch the inner thigh during a gentle inward press of the leg. Do not dig to separate this strap from the adductors.
feel.zh: 轻轻把腿往内收，手轻触大腿内侧；不要用力按，试图把这条薄肌与收肌分开。

mistakes.en: Forcing a stance wider than the hips can comfortably manage.
mistakes.zh: 把站距撑得太宽，超过髋部舒服的范围。

mistakes.en: Swinging the leg or turning the pelvis to move the cable.
mistakes.zh: 甩腿或转动骨盆来拉动绳索。

summary.en: Adducts the hip and helps bend the knee.
summary.zh: 内收髋关节，并协助屈膝。

detail.en: This strap spans hip and knee and joins sartorius and semitendinosus at the pes anserinus [M109]. It is an adductor and assistant knee flexor, not one of the usual three hamstrings. Changing knee position also changes its length during hip adduction. It is superficial on the inner thigh; the intermediate layer here is a viewing group, not a claim that it lies deep everywhere.
detail.zh: 股薄肌跨髋、膝，与缝匠肌、半腱肌共同构成鹅足 [M109]。它是内收肌，也协助屈膝，但不属于通常所说的三块腘绳肌。练髋内收时，膝的姿势也会改变它的长度。它位于大腿内侧浅表；本图的中层是观察分组，不表示它处处都在深面。

text.en: Anterior superior iliac spine and the notch immediately below it.
text.zh: 髂前上棘及其紧下方的切迹。

text.en: Upper medial tibia, forming the superficial part of the pes anserinus.
text.zh: 胫骨上端内侧面，构成鹅足的浅层部分。

direction.en: A long strap crosses from the outer front hip to the inner knee.
direction.zh: 长带状纤维从髋前外侧斜跨到膝内侧。

feel.en: While seated, gently lift a bent knee up and out. Trace the diagonal route on the thigh lightly; touch cannot isolate the muscle.
feel.zh: 坐着把弯曲的膝轻轻向外上方抬。沿大腿前方斜线轻轻认位置，不能靠触摸把它单独分出来。

mistakes.en: Forcing a cross-legged position by pushing on the knee.
mistakes.zh: 用手强压膝盖，硬凹盘腿姿势。

mistakes.en: Twisting a planted knee instead of turning at the hip.
mistakes.zh: 脚踩地时扭膝，用它代替髋的转动。

summary.en: Helps lift and turn the thigh and bend the knee.
summary.zh: 协助抬腿、外展外旋大腿和屈膝。

detail.en: The long diagonal strap crosses hip and knee [M109]. Hip flexion, abduction and external rotation combined with knee flexion produce a cross-legged position. Exercise links show assistance during leg return, abduction or knee bending; they are not isolation exercises.
detail.zh: 缝匠肌斜跨大腿前面，同时跨髋、膝 [M109]。屈髋、外展、外旋再加屈膝，可形成盘腿姿势。列出的动作中，它在腿回位、外展或屈膝时协助工作，并不是专门孤立练缝匠肌的动作。

text.en: Anterior superior iliac spine and outer lip of the anterior iliac crest.
text.zh: 髂前上棘及髂嵴前部外唇。

text.en: Iliotibial tract between its fascial layers on the lateral thigh.
text.zh: 大腿外侧髂胫束的筋膜层之间。

direction.en: Short bundles descend from the front outer hip into the long fascial tract.
direction.zh: 短肌束从髋前外侧向下，进入长条筋膜束。

feel.en: Touch just behind and below the front point of the iliac crest as the leg lifts gently forward and out. Avoid deep groin pressure.
feel.zh: 手放在髂嵴前端骨点的后下方，轻轻把腿向前外侧抬；避开腹股沟，不要深按。

mistakes.en: Turning the foot inward forcefully to chase a stronger burn.
mistakes.zh: 为了更酸胀而使劲把脚尖拧向内。

mistakes.en: Treating outer-knee pain as proof this muscle is tight.
mistakes.zh: 把膝外侧痛直接当作阔筋膜张肌太紧。

summary.en: Tensions the lateral fascia and assists hip motion.
summary.zh: 张紧外侧筋膜，并协助髋运动。

detail.en: A small muscle at the front outer hip that tensions the iliotibial tract [M109]. Its hip actions differ from gluteus maximus even though both connect to that tract. Lunges involve pelvic and thigh control. The tract transmits tension; it does not actively contract.
detail.zh: 阔筋膜张肌位于髋前外侧，收缩时拉紧髂胫束 [M109]。虽然它与臀大肌都连到髂胫束，髋部作用却不同。弓步中，它参与控制骨盆和大腿。髂胫束传递张力，自身不会主动收缩。

text.en: A thickening of the lateral fascia lata attached proximally to the outer iliac crest; receives tensor fasciae latae and gluteus maximus fibres. These are fascial attachments, not a muscle origin.
text.zh: 阔筋膜外侧增厚部，上端连于髂嵴外侧，接受阔筋膜张肌及臀大肌纤维；这是筋膜附着，不是肌肉起点。

text.en: Lateral tibial condyle at the iliotibial tract tubercle (Gerdy tubercle), with connections to surrounding knee fascia.
text.zh: 胫骨外侧髁的髂胫束结节（Gerdy 结节），并连于周围膝部筋膜。

direction.en: Collagen bundles run mainly down the outer thigh; they are not contractile muscle fibres.
direction.zh: 胶原纤维束主要沿大腿外侧纵行，不是会收缩的肌纤维。

feel.en: Trace the outer thigh lightly towards the outer knee. This is a fascial region, not a muscle belly to squeeze.
feel.zh: 轻轻沿大腿外侧认到膝外侧；找的是筋膜区域，不是能收紧的肌腹。

mistakes.en: Trying to strengthen the tract as if it were a muscle.
mistakes.zh: 把髂胫束当肌肉，想练到它主动收缩。

mistakes.en: Pressing hard on a painful outer knee.
mistakes.zh: 膝外侧疼时仍用力按压。

summary.en: A fascial strap that transmits tension at the outer knee.
summary.zh: 大腿外侧传递张力的筋膜束。

detail.en: The iliotibial tract is the thick lateral part of the fascia lata, receiving tensor fasciae latae and much of gluteus maximus [M109]. It transmits their tension to the outer tibia and contributes to support around the knee; it cannot actively shorten like a muscle. Its long parallel bundles are collagen, not muscle fibres. Exercise links involve the connected muscles and support-leg control.
detail.zh: 髂胫束是阔筋膜外侧增厚的部分，接受阔筋膜张肌及大部分臀大肌的止腱 [M109]。它把这些肌肉的张力传至胫骨外侧，参与膝周支撑；自身不能像肌肉一样主动缩短。纵向平行束是胶原束，并非肌纤维。动作链接展示相连肌肉和支撑腿控制。

text.en: Medial head: upper posterior medial femoral condyle and adjacent femur. Lateral head: lateral femoral condyle and posterior femur above it. Both also arise from the knee capsule.
text.zh: 内侧头：股骨内侧髁后上部及邻近股骨；外侧头：股骨外侧髁侧面及其上方后面。两头也起于膝关节囊。

text.en: Posterior calcaneus through the calcaneal tendon (Achilles tendon), shared with soleus.
text.zh: 经跟腱止于跟骨后面，与比目鱼肌共用跟腱。

direction.en: Two bulging heads descend into a broad aponeurosis and the calcaneal tendon.
direction.zh: 两个隆起的头向下汇入宽腱膜，再进入跟腱。

feel.en: Lightly touch the upper calf while rising onto the balls of the feet with the knees comfortably straight.
feel.zh: 膝自然伸直，轻轻提踵，手摸小腿后上方。

mistakes.en: Bouncing out of the bottom of a heel raise.
mistakes.zh: 提踵到底时借反弹。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘，用外侧承重。

summary.en: Crosses knee and ankle; raises the heel.
summary.zh: 跨膝、踝，提起脚跟。

detail.en: Both heads cross knee and ankle [M109]. Bending the knee shortens the muscle at its upper end, changing its working length in a seated heel raise. Soleus crosses only the ankle. The seated curl link shows assistance in knee flexion, not a substitute for calf raises.
detail.zh: 腓肠肌两头都跨膝、踝 [M109]。屈膝会让上端缩短，坐姿提踵时的工作长度因此改变。比目鱼肌只跨踝。腿弯举链接展示它协助屈膝，不能替代提踵。

text.en: Upper posterior medial femoral condyle and adjacent femur, with the underlying knee capsule.
text.zh: 股骨内侧髁后上部及邻近股骨，并包括下方膝关节囊。

text.en: Posterior calcaneus through the calcaneal tendon (Achilles tendon), shared with soleus.
text.zh: 经跟腱止于跟骨后面，与比目鱼肌共用跟腱。

direction.en: Oblique bundles descend from the knee into the broad calf aponeurosis.
direction.zh: 斜行肌束从膝附近向下进入小腿腱膜。

feel.en: Touch the inner upper calf during a gentle heel raise, away from the back of the knee.
feel.zh: 轻轻提踵时摸小腿后上方内侧，避开膝窝。

mistakes.en: Bouncing out of the bottom of a heel raise.
mistakes.zh: 提踵到底时借反弹。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘，用外侧承重。

summary.en: Raises the heel and assists knee flexion.
summary.zh: 提踵，并协助屈膝。

detail.en: This head forms the inner bulge of the upper calf and joins the common calcaneal tendon [M109]. It crosses knee and ankle; bent-knee raises start it shorter. Turning the toes is not a reliable way to isolate a head. The curl link is an assisting role, and seated raises also involve soleus.
detail.zh: 这一头形成小腿肚上方的内侧隆起，并进入共同跟腱 [M109]。它跨膝、踝，屈膝提踵的起始长度较短。转动脚尖不能可靠地孤立练某一个头。腿弯举中它是协同肌；坐姿提踵也会用到比目鱼肌。

text.en: Lateral femoral condyle and posterior femur just above it, with the underlying knee capsule.
text.zh: 股骨外侧髁侧面及其上方股骨后面，并包括下方膝关节囊。

text.en: Posterior calcaneus through the calcaneal tendon (Achilles tendon), shared with soleus.
text.zh: 经跟腱止于跟骨后面，与比目鱼肌共用跟腱。

direction.en: Oblique bundles descend from the knee into the broad calf aponeurosis.
direction.zh: 斜行肌束从膝附近向下进入小腿腱膜。

feel.en: Touch the outer upper calf during a gentle heel raise, away from the back of the knee.
feel.zh: 轻轻提踵时摸小腿后上方外侧，避开膝窝。

mistakes.en: Bouncing out of the bottom of a heel raise.
mistakes.zh: 提踵到底时借反弹。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘，用外侧承重。

summary.en: Raises the heel and assists knee flexion.
summary.zh: 提踵，并协助屈膝。

detail.en: This head forms the outer bulge of the upper calf and joins the common calcaneal tendon [M109]. It crosses knee and ankle; bent-knee raises start it shorter. Turning the toes is not a reliable way to isolate a head. The curl link is an assisting role, and seated raises also involve soleus.
detail.zh: 这一头形成小腿肚上方的外侧隆起，并进入共同跟腱 [M109]。它跨膝、踝，屈膝提踵的起始长度较短。转动脚尖不能可靠地孤立练某一个头。腿弯举中它是协同肌；坐姿提踵也会用到比目鱼肌。

text.en: Posterior fibular head and upper shaft, soleal line and medial border of the tibia, and a tendinous arch between tibia and fibula.
text.zh: 腓骨头后面及腓骨干上部、胫骨比目鱼肌线与内侧缘，以及胫腓骨间的腱弓。

text.en: Posterior calcaneus through the calcaneal tendon.
text.zh: 经跟腱止于跟骨后面。

direction.en: Short oblique bundles feed broad aponeuroses deep to gastrocnemius.
direction.zh: 短斜行肌束在腓肠肌深面汇入宽腱膜。

feel.en: In a seated heel raise, notice the lower calf beside the Achilles tendon. The deep muscle cannot be completely separated by touch.
feel.zh: 坐姿提踵时，留意跟腱两侧的小腿下部；深层肌肉无法靠触摸完全分清。

mistakes.en: Bouncing out of the bottom of a heel raise.
mistakes.zh: 提踵到底时借反弹。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘，用外侧承重。

summary.en: Raises the heel without crossing the knee.
summary.zh: 提踵，但不跨膝关节。

detail.en: This broad flat muscle lies under gastrocnemius and crosses only the ankle [M109]. Knee bending does not shorten it across the knee as it does gastrocnemius. It works in standing and seated heel raises. The squat link shows control of forward shin movement, not an isolated soleus exercise.
detail.zh: 比目鱼肌宽而扁，位于腓肠肌深面，只跨踝 [M109]。屈膝不会像腓肠肌那样从膝端使它缩短。站姿和坐姿提踵都会用到它。深蹲链接展示它控制小腿前倾，不能把深蹲当作单独练比目鱼肌的动作。

text.en: Lateral tibial condyle, upper lateral tibial shaft, interosseous membrane and deep leg fascia.
text.zh: 胫骨外侧髁、胫骨干上部外侧面、骨间膜及小腿深筋膜。

text.en: Medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal, on their medial and plantar surfaces.
text.zh: 内侧楔骨及第 1 跖骨底的内侧面、跖面。

direction.en: Bundles descend beside the shin into a tendon crossing the front of the ankle towards the inner foot.
direction.zh: 肌束沿胫骨外侧下行，汇入跨踝前、走向足内侧的肌腱。

feel.en: Put fingertips just outside the shin bone and lift the forefoot with the heel down; the muscle firms beneath them.
feel.zh: 指尖放在胫骨前缘外侧，脚跟不动，抬起前脚掌；指下的肌肉会变硬。

mistakes.en: Lifting only the toes instead of the whole forefoot.
mistakes.zh: 只翘脚趾，没有抬起整个前脚掌。

mistakes.en: Rocking the body to fling the foot upwards.
mistakes.zh: 靠身体前后晃把脚甩起来。

summary.en: Lifts the forefoot and helps turn the sole inward.
summary.zh: 抬起前脚掌，并协助足内翻。

detail.en: The shin muscle pulls the forefoot towards the leg and reaches the inner midfoot [M109]. Its route differs from the long toe-extensor tendons. During walking it helps control forefoot lowering after heel contact. The three linked drills practise dorsiflexion or holding it; none promises to prevent all causes of shin pain.
detail.zh: 胫骨前肌把前脚掌拉向小腿，肌腱到足内侧中部 [M109]。路线与长伸趾肌腱不同。走路脚跟着地后，它也参与控制前脚掌落下。三个动作练背屈或保持背屈，不能据此承诺预防所有小腿前侧疼痛。

text.en: Sides of the last thoracic and lumbar vertebral bodies, intervening discs and lumbar transverse processes.
text.zh: 第 12 胸椎及腰椎椎体侧面、椎间盘和腰椎横突。

text.en: Lesser trochanter through the iliopsoas tendon.
text.zh: 经髂腰肌腱止于股骨小转子。

direction.en: Long bundles descend beside the lumbar spine and cross the front of the hip.
direction.zh: 长肌束沿腰椎两侧向下，跨过髋前方。

feel.en: It is deep in the abdomen; do not press inside to find it. Notice front-hip effort when gently lifting a knee.
feel.zh: 它在腹部深处，不要靠深按去找。轻抬膝时可留意髋前的用力感。

mistakes.en: Digging into the abdomen to feel the muscle.
mistakes.zh: 深按腹部，想摸到腰大肌。

mistakes.en: Arching the back to lift the knee higher.
mistakes.zh: 靠下背后仰把膝抬得更高。

summary.en: Flexes the hip from beside the lumbar spine.
summary.zh: 从腰椎两侧深处牵拉，使髋屈曲。

detail.en: Shown as a neighbour, with iliacus forming iliopsoas [M109]. The links involve the returning or stepping leg, not a loaded hip-flexor programme. Lumbar attachments make its role more complex than lifting the knee; posture alone cannot diagnose its length or strength.
detail.zh: 作为邻区显示，与髂肌共同构成髂腰肌 [M109]。链接展示回位腿或迈步腿的参与，不是负重练髋屈肌的计划。它附着腰椎，作用不只是抬膝；不能只看姿势就判断它的长度或力量。

text.en: Upper iliac fossa, inner lip of the iliac crest, anterior sacroiliac and iliolumbar ligaments, and base of the sacrum.
text.zh: 髂窝上部、髂嵴内唇、骶髂前韧带及髂腰韧带，并包括骶骨底。

text.en: Iliopsoas tendon and the femur at and just below the lesser trochanter.
text.zh: 汇入髂腰肌腱，并止于股骨小转子及其下方。

direction.en: A fan in the iliac fossa narrows towards the front of the hip.
direction.zh: 髂窝内的扇形纤维向髋前汇聚。

feel.en: This lies inside the pelvis; avoid deep groin pressure. Notice front-hip effort as the knee rises gently.
feel.zh: 它位于骨盆里面，不要深按腹股沟去找。轻抬膝时可留意髋前方用力。

mistakes.en: Pressing deeply beside the groin vessels.
mistakes.zh: 在腹股沟血管附近深按。

mistakes.en: Assuming every front-hip pinch is a muscle problem.
mistakes.zh: 把髋前夹痛全都当作肌肉问题。

summary.en: A pelvic fan that helps lift the thigh.
summary.zh: 骨盆内的扇形肌，协助抬大腿。

detail.en: Iliacus fills the iliac fossa and joins psoas major towards the lesser trochanter [M109]. It flexes the hip without starting on the lumbar spine. The links involve swing-leg motion; they do not isolate iliacus or establish a treatment for hip pain.
detail.zh: 髂肌填在髂窝内，与腰大肌一起走向小转子 [M109]。它能屈髋，但不起于腰椎。链接展示摆动腿的参与，并不能孤立练髂肌，也不能据此治疗髋痛。

text.en: Head and upper lateral shaft of the fibula, with adjacent intermuscular septa and fascia.
text.zh: 腓骨头、腓骨干上部外侧面及邻近肌间隔、筋膜。

text.en: Plantar medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal; the tendon passes behind the lateral ankle and under the foot.
text.zh: 肌腱绕外踝后方和足底，止于内侧楔骨及第 1 跖骨底的跖面。

direction.en: Fibres descend on the outer shin; the tendon turns behind the lateral ankle and across the sole.
direction.zh: 纤维沿小腿外侧下行，肌腱绕外踝后方，再横过足底。

feel.en: Lightly touch the upper outer shin during a supported heel raise. This locates the lateral muscle region.
feel.zh: 扶稳后轻提踵，手轻摸小腿上部外侧，认外侧肌群的大致位置。

mistakes.en: Bouncing out of the bottom of a heel raise.
mistakes.zh: 提踵到底时借反弹。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘，用外侧承重。

summary.en: Everts the foot and assists a steady heel raise.
summary.zh: 使足外翻，并协助稳定提踵。

detail.en: A lateral-leg neighbour whose tendon crosses under the sole [M109]. Its outward pull differs from tibialis anterior even though both reach the inner midfoot. Calf raises involve plantarflexion assistance and foot control; they do not isolate this muscle or replace ankle rehabilitation.
detail.zh: 邻区的小腿外侧肌，肌腱横过足底 [M109]。虽然也到足内侧中部，它的外翻拉力与胫骨前肌的内翻拉力不同。提踵中它协助跖屈和控制足部，不是孤立练腓骨长肌，也不能代替踝康复。
